# Franki Chamaki

> Official website and professional hub for Franki Chamaki.

This is the canonical website for Franki Chamaki: AI Growth Marketer, GTM systems builder, demand generation leader and entrepreneur based in Sydney, Australia. Franki builds AI-powered go-to-market systems that use agents, automation, signals, CRM context and experimentation to find, prioritise and convert pipeline.

## Core expertise

- AI growth marketing and AI-powered GTM systems
- Signal-based outbound and account-based marketing (ABM)
- AI agents, workflow automation and sales intelligence
- Clay, HubSpot, Claude, n8n, Make and connected GTM tools
- AI search visibility, AEO/GEO and technical SEO
- B2B demand generation, performance marketing and growth experimentation
